forks.decision: External tasks run fully native with a local checkout without upstream history, a local uv venv or Go/Rust toolchain, and our replay of the instance's FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS tests; no Docker

contradictions: Contract 'run_plan stamp seam' and Approach 5 (bench-panel-manifest.md:61,82) say run.run_plan is 'implemented by c5', yet AC-5's Test Contracts row (:124) puts test_panels.py::test_run_plan_rows_carry_panel_stamp, which calls run.run_plan(cells, panel=...) and stores through it, inside c3's own verification gate ('cd benchmark && python3 -m pytest tests exits 0, including the new test_panels.py', :24) with per_layer_green: required (:22). c3 lands in the layer before c5 (benchmark-gepa-overhaul.md:20), c5 lists run.run_plan as its own output (bench-evolution-loop.md:11,118), and run_plan's ledger parameter needs c1's follow-up spend.SpendLedger (bench-evolution-loop.md:43). No run_plan exists when c3 lands, so c3 cannot go green as written. Cook either builds c5's run_plan inside c3 or ships a red test.

Contract 'Committed panel' and Approach 7 (bench-panel-manifest.md:66,84) commit 'the dataset row of every gepa-v1 external member' from the real pinned datasets into the tilth checkout under benchmark/tests/fixtures/panels/gepa-v1-rows/, and AC-7 (:113,126) loads them 'through the real c2 row-to-ExternalTask path'. That path builds gold_patch from the row's patch (bench-external-tasks.md:134), so the committed rows must carry the real gold `patch`, `test_patch`, and FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS lists. c2's contract says dataset rows, gold patches, held-out tests, and F2P/P2P lists 'live only in $TILTH_BENCH_DATA ... outside the tilth checkout' (bench-external-tasks.md:47), and the parent says 'Held-out tests stay in the harness data directory' (benchmark-gepa-overhaul.md:88). The spec puts real grader material into the repo tree that agents and the evolve proposer's source export are kept away from.
unsupported_assumptions: Approach 1 (bench-panel-manifest.md:78) says 'Tests stub only admit, the store path, and the model-runner launch'. The run.main tests (AC-1 test_complete_panel_reaches_runner and the container test, AC-2, and AC-5 test_stored_rows_carry_panel_stamp, :120-124) still hit c2's separate run.py guard, which exits before any model call for an external cell that has no cached admitted verdict under the current env fingerprint (bench-external-tasks.md:78,133; c2 test test_unadmitted_external_cell_refused). Stubbing admit in load_panel does not satisfy that guard. Either these c3 tests fail, or Cook seeds c2's private verdict cache, or Cook bypasses c2's guard for panel runs. The spec chooses none of these.

The same 'stub only admit, store path, runner launch' seam (bench-panel-manifest.md:78,120,124) runs run.main --panel over the real local members rg_search_dispatch, rg_trait_implementors, gin_servehttp_flow, and gin_edit_render_context. At 87f2e73, run.main sys.exit(1)s when a selected REPOS repo is not cloned under /tmp/tilth_bench/repos (benchmark/run.py:1386-1394, benchmark/config.py:87). gin_edit_render_context also hard-codes FIXTURE=/tmp/tilth_bench/repos/gin (benchmark/tasks/gin_render_context_tasks.py:12), and the container test keeps run_single real, so local cells copy those clones through _agent_repo. Those clones are absent on this host, so the verification gate (:24) depends on host state unless Cook adds stubs the spec excludes.

External members get registered into the process TASKS dict only on the run.py --panel path (Contract 'Run wiring' :58, Approach 4 :81). load_panel only resolves them (:80). The run_plan seam c3 defines (:61,95) does not say who registers external members before run_single looks them up in TASKS (run.py:479,518 at HEAD). c3's rule that 'a name that collides with an existing TASKS entry is refused' (:58) would also refuse a second registration in the same process, and evolve calls run_plan once per candidate. As a result, evolve external cells, the main paid consumer, either KeyError or are refused on the second candidate, and neither c3 nor c5 (bench-evolution-loop.md:43,118) assigns the fix.
acceptance_gaps: Contract 'Row stamp' (bench-panel-manifest.md:60) and AC-5 (:111) stamp panel_split from Panel.stamp(task_name). test_stored_rows_carry_panel_stamp and test_run_plan_rows_carry_panel_stamp (:124) only check that the three fields are present and that run_key does not change, and test_reused_row_output_carries_stamp checks only presence. No test checks that panel_split equals the member's tier (cheap, dev, or test) or that panel_name equals the panel's name. An implementation that stamps every row panel_split: dev, or stamps the wrong name, passes every listed test, and that mislabels test-split rows as dev for any consumer that reads the row field.

Contract 'Split digest' (bench-panel-manifest.md:53) says split_digest covers only the sorted id lists per tier, so 'fallback_reason text [does] not change it'. The only digest test is test_fallback_panel_loads (:122), which checks that the fallback and primaries digests differ. An implementation that hashes the whole panel file or every member field passes it. That implementation makes the split lock refuse a reason-text or other non-split edit after results exist, and no test notices.
